tools.name: search_parts
tools.title: Search car parts
tools.description:
Find spare-part candidates in JOY's Bangladesh catalogue; use search_vehicles for whole cars.

- Build filters from the buyer's intent: query names the item or OEM reference; make/chassis identify its vehicle. For example, combine Toyota, NZE141 and 'brake pads'. If nothing matches, clarify item text/category before changing a known vehicle identity.
- Ask whether the buyer needs stocked supply or human sourcing before choosing the stock/RFQ flags. A catalogue-only match is an enquiry candidate, not a confirmed offer. Keep the chosen filters fixed while paging.
- Anonymous live read. Empty results are valid; an uninterpretable Bangla query returns an error. Read get_part for the selected part_id, then prepare_part_handoff after fitment review. Search does not reserve stock.

query.description: Part name, OEM reference or vehicle words in English, Bangla or Banglish; e.g. 'Axio brake pads' or 'টয়োটা এক্সিও ব্রেক প্যাড'. Omit for filtered browsing; not a part_id lookup.

make.description: Vehicle manufacturer, e.g. Toyota; narrows part candidates alongside the query. Omit if unknown.

chassis.description: Vehicle chassis/model code, e.g. NZE141 or G05; not a full VIN. Narrows candidates and does not certify fitment.

category.description: Public category label from a catalogue result, e.g. Brakes. Omit if the category is unknown.

in_stock_only.description: True requests currently in-stock candidates; false (default) permits other public availability states. This does not reserve stock.

include_rfq_catalogue.description: True also includes catalogue-only templates requiring a human parts request; false (default) omits them. Inclusion does not make an item directly purchasable.

max_price_bdt.description: Inclusive maximum retail asking price in Bangladesh taka (BDT), e.g. 5000 means ৳5,000; omit for no budget ceiling. Not lakh units and not a currency conversion.

page.description: One-based results page, 1 through 500; defaults to 1. Increment to retrieve the next page with the same filters.

page_size.description: Maximum results requested per page, 1 through 20; defaults to 10. total describes all matches, not this page's item count.

tools.name: get_part
tools.title: Get part details
tools.description:
Read one spare part's public price, availability and fitment restrictions; search_parts supplies its ID.

- Copy the selected part_id unchanged. An OEM match can identify several catalogue entries: keep each entry's price, stock and fitment evidence together instead of borrowing facts from another matching entry.
- A found item can remain unsellable. Use its minimum quantity and required fitment information when discussing an enquiry through prepare_part_handoff; unknown price or stock is not zero.
- Anonymous fresh lookup; no supply is reserved or fitment certified. On a missing-ID error, search again rather than declaring the OEM part unavailable everywhere.

part_id.description: Exact catalogue part_id copied from search_parts, e.g. BRK-AXIO-01. This is JOY's catalogue identifier, not an OEM part number or a product URL.

bulk_pricing.description: Public storefront bulk-pricing metadata; not an accepted or locked quote.

tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.title: Search cars for sale
tools.description:
Discover cars for sale in JOY Auto Exchange; use get_vehicle for detail, compare_vehicles for a shortlist or search_auctions for auction links.

- Separate manufacturer and model: make='Toyota', query='Premio', max_price_bdt=3000000 expresses a Premio within 30 lakh. Filters intersect; a single 'Toyota Premio' phrase can miss a listing whose fields store those words separately.
- Choose a priced-budget search or POA discovery deliberately. include_unpriced does not cancel numeric price bounds; omit both bounds when unknown-price cars must remain candidates. Asking prices are neither bids nor valuations.
- Anonymous live read. Keep filters/sort fixed while paging; empty results are valid and missing prices remain unknown. Verification is inspection evidence, not a warranty. No seller is contacted or car reserved.

query.description: Case-insensitive phrase within make, model or trim; use query='Premio' with make='Toyota', not one combined 'Toyota Premio' phrase. Known Bangla/Banglish vocabulary is normalized; unsupported words may be dropped. Use known English model words for precision; omit to browse.

make.description: Case-insensitive manufacturer prefix, e.g. Toyota. Combine with query='Premio' for that model; omit to include all makes.

fuel_type.description: Case-insensitive prefix of a public listing's fuel label, e.g. hybrid. Copy a known label where possible; omit to include all fuel types.

verified_only.description: True requires the storefront's verified flag, approved inspection status and a non-empty inspection ID; false (default) also permits other public listings. Verification is not a vehicle warranty.

include_unpriced.description: True includes price-on-application or otherwise unpriced listings; false (default) excludes them. A missing asking price is unknown, never zero.

min_year.description: Inclusive earliest model year, 1950 through 2100. Omit for no lower-year filter; supply a value no greater than max_year.

max_year.description: Inclusive latest model year, 1950 through 2100. Omit for no upper-year filter; supply a value no less than min_year.

min_price_bdt.description: Inclusive minimum stated asking price in Bangladesh taka, e.g. 2000000 means ৳20 lakh. Omit for no minimum; no greater than max_price_bdt.

max_price_bdt.description: Inclusive maximum stated asking price in Bangladesh taka, e.g. 3000000 means ৳30 lakh. Omit for no maximum; no less than min_price_bdt.

sort.description: Result order: latest (default: verified first, then newest), price_asc (lowest stated price first), price_desc (highest first), or year_desc (newest model year first). Stable tie-breaks support paging; no valuation is performed.

page.description: One-based results page, 1 through 500; defaults to 1. Keep filters and sort unchanged when paging.

page_size.description: Maximum results requested per page, 1 through 20; defaults to 10. total is the matching population, which may exceed this page's item count.

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.title: Get car details
tools.description:
Read a car listing's public specifications, asking price and inspection evidence; search_vehicles discovers candidates and compare_vehicles compares them.

- Resolve an ID or slug to the returned canonical listing_id before counting offers. It identifies an advertisement; multiple advertisements do not establish independent inspection evidence.
- Pass a non-empty auction_id to get_auction; an absent link means unknown auction status. Use search_auctions for discovery and prepare_vehicle_handoff for a selected car's human enquiry.
- Anonymous fresh lookup. Missing facts stay unknown; a not-found listing requires a fresh search. Seller contacts and reserve prices stay private, and nothing is reserved.

vehicle_id.description: listing_id returned by search_vehicles, or slug from a public JOY listing URL. Use only the ID/slug (letters/digits, dots, underscores, hyphens; starts with a letter/digit), not the URL, VIN or registration number.

tools.name: get_auction
tools.title: Read public car auction status
tools.description:
Observe one car auction's public bid state; search_auctions discovers IDs and get_vehicle supplies the linked car's facts.

- Select auction_id from the same discovery/detail record as the car being discussed. It identifies a sale event, not the vehicle advertisement: never substitute listing_id or carry a bid between auction IDs.
- A saved event ID does not imply an open auction. Read status/end_at and refresh the snapshot before answering a bid question. minimum_next_bid is optional; an asking price cannot fill a missing bid value.
- Anonymous observation only. Feature gating, rate limits or an unknown event can return errors; report them without bypass. Reserves and bidder identities stay private. Bidding requires a verified dealer and human decision outside this tool.

auction_id.description: Copy auction_id from search_auctions or an auction-linked get_vehicle result, or use a known public auction ID supplied by the buyer. Supply the event identifier alone, not a listing_id or URL; never invent one.

tools.name: search_auctions
tools.title: Discover car auction links
tools.description:
Discover existing public car-auction IDs for get_auction; use get_vehicle for a known listing's details.

- Express the desired car, not an auction title or bid: make='Toyota' scans that manufacturer's listings; add query='Premio' only for a model-specific request. Unpriced cars remain eligible because an auction need not have an asking price.
- Pagination scans vehicles before extracting their links. Follow next_page even after an empty items page; claim the scan exhausted only when no next page remains and the source limit was not reached. At the limit, narrow the vehicle filters. Source counts are not auction counts.
- Anonymous live read. Check each selected auction's current availability with get_auction; a link may be ended or feature-gated. No private lot is exposed or bid placed.

query.description: Make/model/trim phrase for candidate vehicles, e.g. Premio; omit to scan all public listings. Known Bangla/Banglish vocabulary is normalized.

make.description: Case-insensitive manufacturer prefix, e.g. Toyota; intersects the vehicle query. Omit for all makes.

page.description: One-based source vehicle page; use returned next_page with unchanged filters. This is not a page of guaranteed auction matches.

page_size.description: Public vehicle listings inspected per source page. Auction links can be fewer than this value, including zero.

source_listing_count.description: Matching source vehicle listings across pages; not an auction count.

scanned_listing_count.description: Source vehicle records inspected on this page.

next_page.description: Next source vehicle page; may also contain no auction links. Null at the last page or the page limit.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.title: Compare shortlisted car listings
tools.description:
Compare a selected car shortlist; use search_vehicles to discover candidates or get_vehicle for one car.

- vehicle_ids chooses the adverts to include, in buyer-selected order; it does not rerun search filters. Resolve ID/slug aliases to distinct listing_id values. Repeating an advert must not create extra price evidence or imply another vehicle.
- Keep unknown-price candidates visible when the buyer still wants to consider them. A cheapest result ranks only distinct, known positive prices; inspect price_comparison_complete before describing it as cheapest across the whole shortlist. Asking prices are not valuations.
- Anonymous fresh lookups can partially fail. Inspect not_found/unavailable and retry temporary failures before excluding a candidate. Use prepare_vehicle_handoff after choosing; comparison reserves nothing.

vehicle_ids.description: Two to four listing_id values from search_vehicles or public listing slugs, not VINs or URLs. Choose distinct listings; repeated IDs or an ID and its slug do not provide separate price evidence.

tools.name: get_buying_guide
tools.title: Bangladesh buying terms
tools.description:
Read published Bangladesh retail-parts payment, delivery and human-contact terms before explaining a purchase.

- Call {}. These terms come from the public retail-marketplace configuration, not a product, address or buyer account. Product choice cannot personalize this call: get_part supplies item eligibility and prepare_part_handoff prepares the enquiry.
- Apply the returned zones after learning the buyer's area; confirm quantity/fitment separately from get_part. Retail checkout terms do not establish vehicle, auction or trade-credit terms; route car questions through prepare_vehicle_handoff.
- Anonymous live read. Money objects separate major BDT from minor paisa; vat_bps uses basis points. If live_terms_unavailable=true, ask the human team rather than invent fees. The result is guidance, not an accepted quote; no payment or message starts.

major.description: Decimal amount in major currency units, formatted as text.

tools.name: prepare_vehicle_handoff
tools.title: Prepare a human car enquiry
tools.description:
Prepare a listing link and pre-filled WhatsApp enquiry for a human considering one car; use prepare_part_handoff for spare parts and compare_vehicles before choosing between cars.
Choose vehicle_id from a shortlisted listing, not an auction ID. A slug is resolved to the canonical listing_id before the message is composed. note records the buyer's request; it cannot change the asking price, certify condition or authorize a bid. The link embeds the note, so omit unnecessary personal details.
Anonymous fresh lookup. This is the endpoint of the public research workflow: the human decides whether to open and send the enquiry, then JOY confirms availability, inspection and terms. No seller contact, booking, reservation, bid, order or payment is performed.

vehicle_id.description: A selected listing_id from search_vehicles/compare_vehicles, or a public listing slug. Supply only the ID/slug, not a full URL or VIN.

note.description: Optional human enquiry, e.g. request an inspection or confirm availability. Included in the pre-filled link; not submitted by this tool.

tools.name: prepare_part_handoff
tools.title: Prepare purchase handoff
tools.description:
Prepare product and pre-filled WhatsApp links for a human parts enquiry; use prepare_vehicle_handoff for whole cars.

- First search_parts, then get_part, then copy the selected part_id here. Use get_buying_guide for general terms. Ask the buyer for missing fitment fields identified by get_part; never invent vehicle identity to complete an enquiry.
- Keep quantity as the buyer's requested count, even below the published minimum: explain the gap rather than silently raising it. vehicle supplies fitment context; note can request confirmation but cannot override returned restrictions. Unit price times quantity is not an accepted quote.
- Anonymous fresh lookup. Text is embedded in the link, so omit unnecessary personal details. Nothing opens, sends, reserves, orders or charges; the human decides whether to send and JOY confirms eligibility, fitment, stock and price.

part_id.description: Exact part_id from search_parts/get_part for the selected item; not an OEM reference or product URL. The tool fetches fresh public part detail before composing the links.

quantity.description: Number of units the buyer wants to enquire about, included in the prepared message. This is a request count, not a stock allocation.

vehicle.description: Buyer-provided make/model/year, chassis or VIN text for JOY's human fitment review. Omit if the buyer has not supplied vehicle information.

note.description: Buyer-supplied question or preference copied into the prepared enquiry, such as a request to confirm delivery or bulk terms.
